name: The Siege of Jeomdo
summary: In this narrative-driven RPG, play as Dujom, a retired war veteran compelled to lead Jeomdo Village amidst dire circumstances. Make critical decisions, manage resources, and defend against overwhelming odds.

name: MusicRunner
summary: Welcome to MusicRunner, a new type of rhythm and action game!

name: I Am Dog: Chaos Simulator
summary: Play as a dog and experience the adventure in first-person view!

name: Mikene's Aspects
summary: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

name: Dragon Hop
summary: Put your jumping skills to the test in this beautiful 3D platformer, playing as a dragon! Explore unique areas to find hidden treasures, collect crystals and trade them for skills to help you on your journey. Can you get to the top?

name: The Last Winter Knight
summary: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.

name: Outbound
summary: Build your own home on wheels and live sustainably off-grid. Craft workstations and power supplies, source energy from the sun, wind, or water, upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, automate your production, and explore a colorful world.

name: Sister Ray
summary: 2D RPG about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist called Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.

name: Greenhearth Necromancer
summary: Raise a garden — from the dead! Greenhearth Necromancer is a cozy, witchy, semi-idle game about caring for a balcony garden — living and undead plants alike! Grow cute plants, cast spells, and brew potions, enjoying the chill idle gameplay and balcony ambience throughout your day.

name: Nook Fall: West Town
summary: A charming yet fantastical town, where vitality and decay constantly collide. We hope that through interactions with characters and objects, and the sensory experience created by visuals and sound, you can connect with the emotions and charm of this little world of West Town.

name: Besmirch
summary: Besmirch is a Pixel art Survival Farming-Simulator. Stealthily plant crops and carefully watch them grow. Avoid monsters and unwanted visitors by night. Socialize with the local city-folk but can you actually trust any of them?

name: Boardwalk Builders
summary: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds. Manage and combine your attractions to create even grander experiences. Host festivals, attract VIPs and stay ahead of shifting demand influenced by local events and rival businesses.

name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
summary: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

name: Chart Weaver
summary: Break the board with powerful synergies, discover game-defining relics and alter your deck in this market-inspired roguelike! Chart Weaver is a mesmerizingly simple but deep score-attack deckbuilder where you create magnificent combos and weave intricate patterns.

name: Chill & Reel
summary: A cozy idle fishing game where you play as an adorable alligator angler. Designed to run in the corner of your screen, it's the perfect companion for work or study—featuring rich animations that make every moment feel like watching a charming short film.

name: Echo's Inc
summary: A first-person psychological horror where you play as Carlos, a late-night worker at Echo’s Inc. Explore the eerie facility, uncover strange occurrences, and escape before it’s too late.

name: Drifting Dots
summary: A minimalist physics roguelite where you create a mesmerizing cascade of droplets. Choose from three distinct modes and discover powerful upgrade synergies to master the flow. Calm, complex, and endlessly replayable.

name: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Clockwork Robot Companion
summary: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

name: Top Down Zombies
summary: Coursing with adrenaline, this ‘top-down’ shooter will push your skill to the limit. Sprint, dash, and blast through endless waves of Reddz while upgrading your loadout to build your firepower. Do whatever you can to survive the red fury.

name: Directive 8020
summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

name: Clockwork Ambrosia
summary: Clockwork Ambrosia is a compelling steampunk fusion of metroidvania and a 2D shooter. Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapons modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

name: Cloud Crashers
summary: Fight for victory across airborne stages in Cloud Crashers, an arena platformer fighting game in the skies. Choose from a diverse roster of characters with unique weapons and abilities, and brawl it out against other Challengers in intense PvP action!

name: Call of the Elder Gods
summary: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

name: Elfie: A Sand Plan
summary: A perfect day at the beach requires sand castles. Help a small ambitious elephant with her ideas in this relaxing geometric puzzle game! Or enjoy building your own!

name: Black Jacket
summary: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

name: FOF: Fear Of Failure
summary: FOF (Fear of Failure) is a physics-based precision platformer where every shot counts. Use the powerful recoil of your shotgun to propel yourself through challenging environments, overcoming obstacles with skill and strategy. one wrong move, and you’ll experience spectacular failure.

name: Uncle Lee’s Cookbook: Five Recipes for Disaster
summary: Uncle Lee has done it again. It’s up to you to pick up the pieces. Join rebellious teen Ines as she deals with the fallout of her uncle Lee’s experiments/inventions/cooking, in a modern point & click adventure in five self-contained episodes.

name: Saint of Chains
summary:
Psychological single-player first-person horror. Explore dark environments, fight with melee and guns, and solve puzzles in this retro 2000s-inspired nightmare where the truth is more terrifying than the monsters.

Retro Horror - Reborn: A love letter to Silent Hill 3, Lost in Vivo, Condemned: Criminal Origins, and Cry of Fear.

Built in the haunting visual style of the PS2 / Xbox360 era — when every shadow felt alive, and every step sounded like a confession.

name: Poolscape
summary: Poolscape is a retro reimagining of the Poolrooms, evoking the nostalgia of classic PSX games by immersing players in the iconic liminal space with authentic ’90s-styled visuals and atmosphere.

name: Octopinbs
summary: A multiplayer action game for 3-10 people. Firefighters (octopuses) must capture the artists (squid) who have infiltrated their ranks! These saboteurs may tell clever tales...but actions never lie.

name: Duel Draw: Katana Clash
summary:
"A lone samurai. Seven trials. One path to enlightenment.
The Crimson Wanderer walks a road few dare to find. At its end stands the enlightened one, undefeated, untouchable, the living myth of the blade.
Between you and him, seven legendary warriors wait in silence. Each one a wall. Each one a lesson.
This is not a battle of strength. It is a battle of stillness. One breath. One moment. One truth.
Honor the fallen. Carry their wisdom. Let each duel shape the swordsman you are becoming.
The path is long. The silence is deep. The enlightened one is waiting."

name: Tennis Manager 26
summary: Step into the most advanced tennis management experience ever. Run your academy, develop top talent, upgrade your staff and facilities, and dominate the junior and pro circuits. A new chapter begins, are you ready to take control?

name: Stitchlings
summary: Stitchlings is a couch co-op action game where the monsters you defeat become parts to stitch onto your character, allowing you to customize your combat style and dress up your Stitchling! Grab a friend and embark on a grand adventure to rekindle a fading world where all you have is each other.

name: Arie: Moonprayer
summary: "Arie: Moonprayer" is a storytelling exploration game. Moon is falling, and the world is ending. Diallo, a man who can sense the memories of the gone, has one last mission on earth: Go up to the peak nearest to the moon with his mentor's daughter, find out the truth of this world.

name: Vultures: Scavengers of Death
summary: Face zombies and fearsome monsters in this turn-based survival-horror roguelike as you seek the path to recover a valuable artifact. Unravel the history of Salento Valley and its downfall after a bioterrorist attack led by a secret cult involved with the powerful corporation Eugenesys Tech.

name: Kami: Parade of Senses
summary: The parade of senses begins and you are forced to become its participant. So make the most of the situation! Explore the Kami Space, help to other forced, who have been trapped here, look for answers to questions, betray, kill... or spare and protect.

name: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
summary: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

name: Zhuishu
summary: Can you hear it? The faint sound coming from an abandoned radio, calling out for forgotten children. Trace back a chilling tale lost to time and unravel the mysteries hidden within the ruins. Who is silently watching you? And who lurks within the fog, waiting for answers?

name: True Vikings
summary: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

name: Kernelbay
summary: A cozy idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. Explore handcrafted islands, unlock new species, upgrade gear and customize each island’s look as you uncover the stories hidden beneath the waves while your fisher works quietly in the background.

name: Monkey Gang
summary: Monkey Gang is an autobattler based on teamwork, where you can create a team of monkeys for fighting waves of enemies! Create strategies, unlock new monkeys, buy upgrades and make unique teams to reach the furthest you can!

name: Mazebound: Hunt, Gather, Run!
summary: In this survival horror, you're surrounded by sea and a towering gate ahead. Walk into the maze, hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. Remember: You're not the only one starving...

name: Rogue Runner
summary: Rogue Runner is a high-speed running, rogue-like, third-person shooter, action, and parkour game. You must run to break the cycle. As you run, you'll discover different possibilities. Run, Kill, Die, Try new skills, and Repeat to break the cycle!

name: Actuator: Overt Abnormality
summary: "Actuator : Overt Abnormality" is a new action RPG that expands your horizons as you level up.

name: Urban Golf: Hot Dog Edition
summary: Break free from the golf course and turn the streets into your fairway! No dress code, no rules — just freedom and creativity as you take golf anywhere.

name: Wingsuit: Romsdalen
summary: Feel the rush of Norway’s Romsdalen Valley in this intense action sports game. Pilot a high-performance wingsuit through challenging exits, daring stunts and vast mountain landscapes. Are you ready to hit the slopes?

name: Inquiry Counsel
summary: "Hold on!" A court battle game set in ancient China's Song Dynasty! In the government office of Lin'an County during the Song Dynasty of ancient China, many bizarre murder cases occurred! The protagonist engages in intense court battles with the county captain of Lin'an to find the real culprit!

name: The Knight of Niraking
summary: Play as the hero to save the land of Niraking from the Nohak Lord. Explore dungeons, castles, and ancient temples. Fight bosses and natural beasts to gather more gear or progress in the story. Talk to NPCs and add some of them to your party to advance your quest.

name: WEJbA: We Exist Just to be Alive
summary: An experimental mixed-media game about being bored and wasting time that combines a 3D world with 2D illustrations and photography of handcrafted plushies.

name: RoadOut
summary:
The world is dominated by an A.I. and rebel groups take refuge in a desert area known as the DeadZone.

Claire survives by executing delivery, sabotage and murder contracts for local leaders, while discovering about her past, revealing strange evidence that links her existence with the origin of the A.I.

name: Enter the Chronosphere
summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

name: Underling Uprising
summary: Play as the Underlings, a group of experiments created by evil mad science, as you seek revenge on your previous captor, the maniacal Dr. Baldrick! On their journey, the Underlings will need to fight across the globe, overcome the demons of their pasts, and accept help from unexpected places.

name: The Clubies
summary: The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

name: A Tale of Silent Depths
summary: A Tale of Silent Depths is a turn based tactical RPG set in a post-apocalyptic underwater setting. Explore a procedurally generated Ocean, command your submarine and fight beasts, pirates and creatures beyond your crew's comprehension.

name: Find Us Cats
summary: Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline companions! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in Level 1 of our free demo, the Planetarium.

name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
summary: A volatile cocktail of action and puzzles, spiced with pitch-black humor and a deliciously sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

name: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul
summary: First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Travel through unique areas, uncover memories and use them to craft powerful potions. Unlock special abilities and solve puzzles in a mysterious world. Will your soul survive this journey?

name: American Truck Simulator: Illinois
summary: Welcome to the beautiful Prairie State! Illinois showcases the best of what the USA has to offer. Hop into your rig, hit the legendary Route 66, and journey through Springfield, the state’s historic capital, to Chicago, one of the Midwest's most iconic cities.

name: Nova Patria
summary: Nova Patria is a Roman Steampunk Colony Sim. In this alternate history, the empire never fell and lived on to discover the New World and steam power. Manage intricate supply chains, expanding cities, and innovations in a hopeful, procedurally generated, isometric simulation of industrial antiquity.

name: Taste of Blood
summary: A real-time strategy game with a simple economy, designed so you can focus on the battle and crush your enemies.

name: Mysteries of Old Tokyo
summary: Step into the Imperial Capital, where knowledge is your weapon. Research and explore 40+ real-life Tokyo locations, past and present. Encounter a cast of wandering spirits, interrogate their stories, and separate the truth from their lies.

name: Port Authority
summary: Port Authority is a real-time harbor management game where you draw routes guiding cargo ships to color-matched docks. Navigate increasingly chaotic traffic through harbors inspired by real-world locations as more vessels arrive. One collision ends it all. How many containers can you deliver?

name: Let Me Play!
summary: After shouting "Let Me Play!" to the cast in a theatre, the fiction comes crashing down as everyone, including you, becomes aware they're only following a script. Will you let the play continue? Or will you write your own ending?

name: Wall Street Raider
summary: Wall Street Raider offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

name: The Melty Way
summary: You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

name: Maze Creep!!
summary: A satire co-op horror game where players aim to reach the end of an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and various other threats.

name: Panzer Corps 2: Allied Operations - Italy: Vol.1
summary: Lead the Allied invasion of Sicily in the opening chapter of a grand trilogy. Command British and American forces across two converging campaigns, carry your veteran core army forward, and relive the historic push that broke open Fortress Europe.

name: King Crab
summary: Dig trenches, build walls, explore the beach, and defend your sandcastle from the rising tide - on PC or in VR.

name: Do Not Feed the Virus
summary: Grow your organism, gather biomass, and expand your colony. A casual, mouse-driven incremental game focused on growth and progression.

name: What'Sub
summary: Work together as a pirate crew and plunder coffee across the oceans! Hold your (t)rusty submarine together, dodge disasters, fight dangers, and finally get the black gold home! Play this co-op action game with up to 4 players and try become the mightiest pirates of the underseas!

name: The Caribou Trail
summary: The WWI story where your goal isn't to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

name: Drifters Don't Brake: Midnight
summary: Drift through different terrains and tackle challenges while your car auto-accelerates nonstop.

name: CaseCracker3
summary: Sift crucial evidence from a sea of data. Reconstruct the case from fragmented narratives. Catch logical gaps hidden between the lines. Unearth the truth from the faintest traces! Youll need sharp logic and keen insight to conquer this fully immersive deduction challenge. Come onIm waiting.

name: Luna's Room
summary: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.

name: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy
summary: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ Skirmish vs AI.

name: Make Way: Legends Pack
summary: Stylishly smash the competition with the Legends Pack!

name: Snack and Quack: Duckling Steps
summary: Quack, Push, and Feed the Ducklings

name: Solo Shift!
summary: From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all! Take on waves of customers all by yourself! Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!

name: Colorizing: Daylight
summary: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

name: Tindark
summary:
Tindark is a loop-style psychological horror puzzle game where players take on the role of a dating-app user tasked with spotting anomalies among their daily matches.

Each day, eight profiles must be reviewed — swipe right on normal profiles, swipe left on anomalies. Reach Day 9 without making a mistake to escape the loop. Inspired by anomaly-spotting horror titles such as The Exit 8, a single playthrough lasts roughly 15 to 60 minutes.

name: Timeless Rain
summary: Explore this foreign world and use manipulate time to defeat any creature who dares to stand between you and your goal! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

name: The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot
summary: A first-person action game that provides various ways for defeating your foes, whether through weaponry, magic, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking into deadly spikes.

name: Shattered Divinities
summary: In Shattered Divinities, embark on an adventure that pits you directly against divinity itself! An ancient War of Gods shattered the world, and their broken power has become the Calamities that consume all life. How will you survive in this land? And how will you uncover the secrets behind the War?

name: The Sintonia Chronicles
summary: Join Maria on an unforgettable journey through the world of Sintonia to rescue her beloved pups. Forge unlikely alliances, face epic bosses, and outsmart every challenge in a universe brimming with magic and adventure.

name: The Island of Doctor Morose
summary: A horror adventure game inspired by the art of Theodor Geisel and the works of HP Lovecraft, featuring a mixture of point and click and survival horror elements.

name: Down with the Ship
summary: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

name: Augment Anthem
summary: A 2D sci-fi metroidvania. Explore Bunker 7, fight biomechanical threats shaped by corrupted superintelligence, and rebuild Haven, humanity's final refuge.

name: Boogie Fungi
summary: Build and maintain a colony of Mushrooms, keep them happy with constant parties and make sure to deploy some defenses to deal with foragers

name: Cat Island Petrichor
summary: "Cat Island Petricolor" is an exploration adventure game set on Japan's summer "Cat Island." Become a cat, explore the island, and uncover the mysteries of Cat Island together with the heroine!

name: Closure
summary: An experimental narrative game that tells its story through sound and memory. Sort through a box of personal momentos and relive memories from a seven-year relationship by closing you eyes in real life.

name: Deathplane
summary: Deathplane is a 2D puzzle-platformer game about moving the actual deathplane below the level up and down to kill enemies and find solutions and secrets.

name: SubZero
summary: A frozen apocalypse. Three unique survivors join you. Lead them through the icy wasteland! Zombie whispers, blizzards blur morality... Hope or doom? The fateful die burns in your grip.

name: Deliria
summary: Fight, build, and conquer wonders in a thrilling infinite 3D sandbox. An adventure without cubes! Play solo or with friends in PvP, co-op, or creative mode—backed by 20+ original soundtracks.

name: Futa Fucks Femboys
summary: Futa Fucks Femboys is an explosive mix of 2D Visual Novel and Collectible Card Game, where an alien symbiote turns the main hero into a FUTANARI and drags her into an adventure full of passion, absurdity, and FEMBOYS. Saving Earth has never felt so spicy

name: Drive Together
summary: One car, many drivers! Team up with your friends and share control of the gas, brakes, and steering to reach the finish line through chaotic tracks. Will it be perfect teamwork, or a total disaster? (Playable with 1–4 players)

name: Pintorino
summary: Ready to challenge your brain? Pintorino is a grid-based puzzle game where you guide a player across the board, aiming to pass through all the required blocks - each with its own unique purpose.

name: Platyguard: Swarm Slayer
summary: PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer is a 2D action roguelike platformer RPG set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, infused with biopunk and dark sci-fi flair. Survive the chaos, clash with mutant foes, and explore mysterious sites in this indie adventure!

name: Centipede Simulator
summary: Experience life as a centipede! Munch on crickets to grow longer and evade deadly predators in a frantic struggle for survival across multiple game modes. How long can you last?

name: Nano Squadron
summary: Nano Squadron is a top-down space roguelite where your nanobot ship evolves mid-battle. Survive relentless alien waves, stack powerful upgrades, and build a ship capable of defending Earth.
